whatWasLearned.estimatorFinding: The games-weighted mean DID recover a nonzero game-level efficiency sigma (0.1027 vs the champion median's 0) — the term is real, and the median estimator was deleting it.
whatWasLearned.whyItStillFails: Coverage moved only 0.5686 -> 0.5707. A ~10% lognormal on per-completion efficiency is small beside the actual gap: the model's own CENTER error (MAE 81.4 yds) is comparable to the interval half-width (~90 yds at 80% nominal), so realized values fall outside the interval because the point prediction is off for that player-game, not because aleatoric spread was underfit. Passing-yards under-coverage is a PREDICTIVE-uncertainty problem (role/rate/center estimation error), not an aleatoric-dispersion problem.
whatWasLearned.namedNextCandidate: Add a predictive-uncertainty term for player_pass_yds fit STRICTLY inside 2023-24: the walk-forward residual variance of the engine's own center predictions over the fit period, carried as an additional independent spread component. Requires its own preregistration with fresh bars before any evaluation; NOT run in this program slice.
whatWasLearned.disallowedShortcut: Post-hoc interval scaling chosen on 2025 would hit the coverage bar by construction and prove nothing — the preregistration bans it and that ban held.
